_about: Villagers whistling as they walk their day plan (scripts/villagers/whistles.gd). Every tune here is our own, a few notes written for Harvest Son in a five-note scale, played by scripts/audio/music_synth.gd on the `whistle` instrument (a flute voice that is almost a pure sine, a little breath and a scoop up into each note). A tune: bpm (two steps a beat), root (MIDI note), scale (semitones) and notes, one token a step as in data/music.json (a scale degree, _ holds, . rests; end on rests so the last note dies away). Each villager's tune matches them: Kota quick and high, Tome slow and low-ish, Hachiro sturdy, Sayo lilting, Yae a careful little figure. A villager without a tune never whistles.
_rules: Once a game minute, each villager on the farmer's map whose pose is in poses (walk = walking their plan; not while acting in an event or turned to talk), on a day whose weather look is in looks (no rain, storm, snow or blizzard: lips shut against the weather), within hours [from, to) (so not in the early morning or after dark), on a map whose ambient is in places (outdoor: no whistling indoors or in the mine), starts their tune with odds chance, but not within gap_minutes of starting the last one. With chance 0.06 and a 40 minute gap a villager walking in view whistles about once in an hour of walking (a game hour is 30 s): now and then, not a radio. The level is 1 within hear_full cells of the farmer and falls to 0 at hear_reach cells (squared, so it fades away softly); volume_db is the level at 1, on the SFX bus. Ours, by ear on paper: not yet heard by a person.
